limits: Only three exact function bodies run with synthetic cm_mod/phdr records, frame reads and file effects; no actual loader ABI or native memory access.
Source snapshots and prior capture are reused privately without rerunning their collector or any prior test matrix.
Modeled unblamed notification does not execute crash persistence, startup quarantine or recovery.
Returned owner does not prove persisted blame; open/write/sync/close failures are modeled, not operating-system failure injection.
Serial plain and ASan/UBSan results do not prove signal safety, volatile once-guard synchronization, concurrent registry publication or lifetime.
No generated-range registry, core repair, hook, signal handler, unwinder, firmware, emulator or device operation.
Leak detection is disabled; no TSan or whole-engine race/lifetime proof.
scope: Three exact SDK attribution functions with synthetic owned records and modeled reads/I/O; fresh process selectors.
toolchain: Apple Clang 16.0.0; arm64-apple-darwin25.2.0; serial host fixture
